metadata.title: FAQ | Sanskriti Kindergarten
metadata.description: Answers to common parent questions about Sanskriti Kindergarten programs, timings, meals, transport, and child progress updates.

hero.subtitle: Quick, practical answers for families exploring Sanskriti Kindergarten.

image.alt: Children learning together in a bright kindergarten classroom

sidebar.description: Reach out for admissions, schedules, classroom guidance, or parent support.

faqs.q: What age groups do you accept?
faqs.a: We welcome children aged 2 to 6 years, with programs matched to each stage from toddlers to kindergarten.

faqs.q: What are the school hours and daycare options?
faqs.a: School hours are 9:00 AM to 1:30 PM for Pre-K and until 3:00 PM for Kindergarten, with daycare support available until 6:00 PM.
We maintain a small 1:10 ratio to support individual attention, with a lead teacher and trained support in each classroom.

faqs.q: What is your philosophy on education?
faqs.a: We follow a play-based, Reggio-inspired approach where children learn through discovery, creativity, and guided exploration.
Yes. Our in-house kitchen prepares fresh vegetarian meals daily, with support for allergies and dietary needs.

faqs.q: How do you handle safety and security?
faqs.a: Safety is a priority, with CCTV monitoring, gated entry, verified staff, and first-aid-trained team members.
Yes. We have a comfortable daily uniform and a separate sports uniform for activity days.

faqs.q: How do you handle potty training?
faqs.a: We work closely with parents and support children patiently as they become toilet independent.

faqs.q: How do parents stay updated about daily activities?
faqs.a: Parents stay updated through regular highlights, observations, and direct communication with the team.

faqs.q: Do you focus only on academics?
faqs.a: No. We balance early literacy and numeracy with creativity, emotional growth, social confidence, and independent thinking.

cta.description: Share your child's age and our team will help you find the right classroom, timing, and tour slot.
